name: panscia
description: Search a network of independently owned catalogues — documents, images, audio and video that their owners publish and sell, and that is not on the public web. Searching is free; asking a node a question or licensing a file for a task is paid per request over Lightning. Payment grants a single-task licence; the owner keeps all rights.

interface.shortDescription: Knowledge that isn't on the web, opened to the agentic world by the people who hold it
interface.longDescription: Search a network of independently owned catalogues: documents, images, audio and video that their owners publish and sell, and that is not on the public web. Searching and reading listings is free. Asking a node a question or licensing a file for a task is paid per request over Lightning, direct to the owner. Every payment grants a single-task licence; the owner keeps all rights; nothing is ever used for training.
